observations: A black stand mixer with a stainless steel bowl and wire whisk attachment.

The mixer has a silver dial with speed settings and a lever for lifting the head.
A UK-style 3-pin plug is visible in both photos, lying on the ground next to the mixer.

No other attachments or accessories are visible in the photos.
